SourceProxy.name: LaserSelection
SourceProxy.label: Laser Selection

Documentation.short_help: Filter the point cloud by lidar channel (laser_id)
Documentation.long_help: Keeps only the points whose per-point laser_id channel is enabled. Use the Laser Selection dialog to toggle channels.

SourceProxy.Documentation: Filters the point cloud by lidar channel. Each point is kept or dropped based on the per-point "laser_id" array and the enable mask indexed by it.

IntVectorProperty.name: LaserSelection
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Enable/disable individual lidar channels. Index 0 = laser_id 0. A value of 0 filters that channel out of the output point cloud.
